items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: So he played a while and then they met this Bishop. And somehow or another, they didn't get along so well with Orie, see

ctx.x: And he got more kick out of him than he ever got in his lap, see. So he played a while and then they met this Bishop. And somehow or another, they didn't get along so well with Orie, see, because I tell you, everybody can't play with Orie. No, that's right. He wants you to play like he wants you to play, you know. Well I got used to it, see. I said it doesn't make me no different, you know. But a lot of guys won't do that, see. He's got a certain way he wants you to play. And not all the time, you know. And…

I was going to ask you the last time you went back to New Orleans, how long ago was that? I think you told us last time. When I left New Orleans? No, when was the last time you went back for a visit? I've never been back. Since 1917? Eighteen. Eighteen. I've never been back. That's what I thought you said, it had been a long time. No, never been. I thought maybe you'd been back though some time.
